name: Asmat Jabeen
emailReply:
Dear Mr. Siddiqui,

Thank you very much for offering me the Brand Ambassador position in the
ChangerMaker Program. I'm excited about the opportunity and would like to
confirm a few details before I accept and get started on September 22.

Could you please clarify the following:

1. Is this a paid or unpaid position? If paid, could you share the
stipend/compensation structure?
2. Is the role remote, in-person, or hybrid? If in-person, what is the
office location and expected working hours/days per week?
3. Who will I be reporting to during the program, and what does a typical
week look like in terms of tasks and deliverables?
4. Will there be a certificate or letter of completion at the end of the 6
weeks, and is there any formal documentation for my university/transcript
if needed?
5. Are there any fees, deposits, or purchases required from my side at any
point during the program?

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Asmat Jabeen

On Thu, Sep 17, 2026, 17:08 DataCrumbs <careers@datacrumbs.org> wrote:

> 📄 ChangerMaker Program Offer – Asmat Jabeen
>
> We are pleased to offer you a position in our *ChangerMaker Program* with
> *DataCrumbs*.
>
> Attached to this email is your official *Offer Letter*. It outlines the
> program duration, responsibilities, and start date.
>
> Kindly review the document thoroughly and *sign and return the offer
> letter* to this email address by the stated deadline to confirm your
> participation.
> ------------------------------
> Next Steps:
>
>    1. Download and review the attached offer letter carefully.
>    2. Sign the offer letter digitally or manually.
>    3. Reply to this email with the signed offer letter attached (PDF or
>    image format).
>    4. Ensure you submit the signed letter before *your start date:
>    September 22, 2026*.
>
> We are excited to welcome you aboard and look forward to working with you.
>
> If you have any questions, feel free to reach out directly by replying to
> this email.
>
> Warm regards,
> *Team DataCrumbs*
> Empowering Future Innovators
>

*Subject:* Acceptance of ChangerMaker Program Offer – Sahil Kumar

Dear Mr. Huzaifa,

Thank you for offering me the opportunity to join the *DataCrumbs
ChangerMaker Program* as a Brand Ambassador.

I am pleased to accept the offer and look forward to being part of the
program. I have attached the *signed offer letter* for your records.

I am excited to begin the program on *September 22, 2026* and look forward
to learning, contributing, and working with the DataCrumbs team.

Best regards,
*Sahil Kumar*
Data Science Student
DHA Suffa University




On Thu, 17 Sep 2026 at 4:36 PM, DataCrumbs <careers@datacrumbs.org> wrote:

> 📄 ChangerMaker Program Offer – Sahil Kumar
>
> We are pleased to offer you a position in our *ChangerMaker Program* with
> *DataCrumbs*.
>
> Attached to this email is your official *Offer Letter*. It outlines the
> program duration, responsibilities, and start date.
>
> Kindly review the document thoroughly and *sign and return the offer
> letter* to this email address by the stated deadline to confirm your
> participation.
> ------------------------------
> Next Steps:
>
>    1. Download and review the attached offer letter carefully.
>    2. Sign the offer letter digitally or manually.
>    3. Reply to this email with the signed offer letter attached (PDF or
>    image format).
>    4. Ensure you submit the signed letter before *your start date:
>    September 22, 2026*.
>
> We are excited to welcome you aboard and look forward to working with you.
>
> If you have any questions, feel free to reach out directly by replying to
> this email.
>
> Warm regards,
> *Team DataCrumbs*
> Empowering Future Innovators
>

Dear DataCrumbs Team,
Thank you for offering me a position in the ChangerMaker Program.
I have reviewed the offer letter, signed it, and attached the signed copy
to this email.
I look forward to joining the program and working with the DataCrumbs team.
Best regards,
Aafaque Ali

> 📄 ChangerMaker Program Offer – Aafaque Ali
>

>

>

> participation.

>    September 22, 2026*.
>
> We are excited to welcome you aboard and look forward to working with you.
>
> If you have any questions, feel free to reach out directly by replying to
> this email.
>
> Warm regards,
> *Team DataCrumbs*
> Empowering Future Innovators
>

Before the program begins, I would appreciate some clarification regarding a few details: Will the program be remote/online, or will there be any on-site requirements? Aiman Adnan

*Acceptance of ChangerMaker Program *

Dear DataCrumbs Team,

Thank you for offering me the opportunity to be part of the ChangerMaker
Program.

I am pleased to accept the offer and look forward to joining the program
and learning with the DataCrumbs team.

Please find my signed offer letter attached for confirmation.

Best regards,
*Khadija Kubra*


On Wed, 16 Sep 2026 at 9:30 PM, Khadija Kubra <khadijakubramehboob@gmail.com>
wrote:

> Hi, thank you for the offer. Before I sign and return the offer letter, I
> just wanted to confirm whether the ChangerMaker Program is fully
> remote/work-from-home or if there are any on-site requirements. Also, could
> you please confirm whether the program is paid or unpaid, and whether there
> are any fees involved from the candidate? Thank you.
>
>

>
>> 📄 ChangerMaker Program Offer – Khadija kubra
>>
>> We are pleased to offer you a position in our *ChangerMaker Program*

>>
>> Attached to this email is your official *Offer Letter*. It outlines the

>>
>> Kindly review the document thoroughly and *sign and return the offer

>> participation.
>> ------------------------------
>> Next Steps:

>>    1. Download and review the attached offer letter carefully.
>>    2. Sign the offer letter digitally or manually.
>>    3. Reply to this email with the signed offer letter attached (PDF or
>>    image format).
>>    4. Ensure you submit the signed letter before *your start date:
>>    September 21, 2026*.
>>
>> We are excited to welcome you aboard and look forward to working with
>> you.
>>
>> If you have any questions, feel free to reach out directly by replying to

>>
>> Warm regards,
>> *Team DataCrumbs*
>> Empowering Future Innovators
>>

name: Ravish Fatima
emailReply:
Dear DataCrumbs Team,

Thank you for selecting me for the DataCrumbs ChangeMaker Program. I am
grateful for this opportunity and excited to learn more about the program.
Before starting, I would appreciate it if you could please elaborate on a
few details regarding the program:

What will be the main purpose and objectives of the ChangeMaker Program?

What kind of tasks and responsibilities will I be expected to perform
during the 6 weeks?

Could you please clarify my exact position/designation and what my role as
a Brand Ambassador will involve?

Will the work mainly involve marketing, student outreach, social media,
community building, or other activities?

What will be the training and mentorship provided during the program?

Will there be any specific targets, working hours, meetings, or weekly
tasks that participants are expected to complete?

Will I receive an experience/completion certificate after successfully
completing the program?

Could you also please clarify whether the program is paid or unpaid, as
this is not mentioned in the offer letter?

I would be grateful if you could provide me with these details so that I
can clearly understand the role, responsibilities, and expectations before
the program begins.
Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Ravish Fatima
Email: ravishsfatimaa6@gmail.com
Phone: +92 309 2944200

> Empowering Future Innovators
>

Kind regards,
Syed Tabish Shah
